THE_ROTATE_GEOMETRY.formula_DERIVED: bit i -> bit (i+r) mod W. (W-r) bits travel r pitches, r bits travel (W-r) pitches (the wrap). Mean |delta index| = 2 r (W-r) / W bit pitches.
THE_ROTATE_GEOMETRY.phase1_case: r = 16, W = 32 -> mean 16.0 bit pitches (the worst case, and the brief's own)
THE_ROTATE_GEOMETRY.brief_cross_check: 32 bits x 16 um x 0.15 fF/um = 76.8 fF. The brief said '~75 fF'. Reproduced.

C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G1_instrument_reproduction: the two committed rows re-run in THIS directory under THIS run's own PYMS_VAE_CACHE must reproduce every .mt0 quantity to <= 1e-6 RELATIVE (or <= 1e-18 absolute for quantities near zero). Any larger deviation is an INSTRUMENT FAILURE, is reported as such, and no result in this run is believed until it is explained.
C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G2_zcs: |I(L_k)| <= 1.0 uA at every commanded open (rise and return, all 4 banks). Rows that fail are reported as instrument failures, not as results.
C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G3_path_identity: |E_out_of_tank - E_switchblock - E_seriesR| <= 1 % of E_out_of_tank, per bank, on the rise.
C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G4_tank_closure: the whole-run integral of V(tnk)*I(L) must equal the tank cap's own 1/2 C (V0^2 - V_end^2); the residual is reported for every bank and is NOT permitted to be silently absorbed.
C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G5_energy_convention_free: every headline energy is the tank's own 1/2 C_t (V0^2 - V1^2) on a LINEAR capacitor, which needs no integrator convention. Integrator numbers are reported as a cross-check, never as the headline.
C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G6_functional: fcrit S3: every gate on the correct side of its RECEIVER's measured trip at the RECEIVER's delivered rail at the instant the receiver commits, by >= 19.323 mV.
C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G7_level_restoring: delivered rail at each bank's own boundary > Vtn + |Vtp| = 0.9642 V.
C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G8_separation: min HIGH - max LOW >= 6.44 mV (the corrected 1-sigma floor) at every depth.
C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G9_comparator_symmetry: the CMOS comparator carries the IDENTICAL wire capacitance, the IDENTICAL cell (wp = 1.12u / wn = 0.74u), the IDENTICAL .OPTIONS, the IDENTICAL 2 ps edges, and its supply is SET EQUAL TO THE QAL VARIANT'S OWN MEASURED DELIVERED RAIL, not to the commanded dV. A ratio computed against a CMOS row at a different voltage or a different load is void.
C_ACCEPTANCE_GATES.G10_no_single_hop_as_chain: no single-hop number is quoted as a chain result and no tank-only energy is quoted as block energy. The chain rows are 4-bank rows; the micro-harness rows are labelled SINGLE HOP in their own name.

D_ROWS_pre_stated.runtime_management: each 4-bank row is ~30 kB of netlist, ~8 MB .prn, ~60 s wall. Each configuration needs 8 sequential ZCS probe decks (short). Configurations are independent, so up to 4 probe chains plus 2 rows run concurrently -- <= 6 heavy Xyce processes, per the brief. The micro-harness decks are single-hop and cheap. No 128-cell deck is run in Phase 1.

E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION._status: written before any Xyce run of this study. I commit to reporting these whichever way they land, and to naming any of them that I miss.
E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.P0_THE_TOPOLOGY_POINT_THAT_DECIDES_IT: In the committed banktank cell the wire capacitance does NOT sit on the resonant node. The inductor charges the bank RAIL; a signal wire hangs on a cell OUTPUT node and is charged FROM the rail THROUGH that cell's own pMOS (w = 1.12 um), a series device that is OUTSIDE the LC loop. The insight 'QAL charges wire through the inductor and takes it back' is therefore, as stated, true of RAIL/clock wire and NOT automatically true of SIGNAL wire. This run is designed to separate those two.
E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.P1_stranding_ceiling_DERIVED: A pull-up output node with its gate at 0 V stops conducting back into a falling rail when it reaches |Vtp| = 0.4403 V. At the committed delivered rail of 1.0007-1.0946 V the CEILING on wire-charge energy return is 1 - (0.4403/V)^2 = 80.6-82.4 %, before any resistive loss. I predict the measured return will be well below that ceiling.
E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.P2_adiabaticity_goes_the_WRONG_way: Adding Cw = 2.400 fF multiplies the output node's RC by (CL+Cw)/CL = 2.20, while the rail ramp lengthens only by sqrt(C_eff'/C_eff) = 1.138 (C_eff 32.71 -> 42.33 fF at n_hi = 5). So the incremental wire charge is delivered LESS adiabatically than the bank's existing load. PREDICTION: the INCREMENTAL recycle fraction comes out BELOW the committed bank average of 17.1-25.4 %; I pre-state 5-20 %.
E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.P3_THE_HEADLINE_I_EXPECT: RATIO_signal = incremental CMOS loss / incremental QAL loss on the same Cw: I predict 0.3x to 1.2x, most likely 0.5-0.8x -- i.e. I do NOT expect QAL to win on signal-wire capacitance in this topology, and I expect it may LOSE. If it wins big I have mispredicted and will say so.
E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.P4_THE_DISCRIMINATING_PREDICTION: RATIO_rail, the same Cw placed ON the resonant node: governed by the loop quality factor (2/pi)*sqrt(L/C_eff)/R = 43.1 at the committed point. I predict 5x-40x in QAL's favour. If P3 and P4 both hold, 'wiring does the rotate and QAL recovers it' is TRUE for rail wire and FALSE for signal wire, and the insight survives only if the rotate permutation can be moved into the charge path -- which is a design conclusion, not a defeat.
E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.P5_rail_droop: 2m/(m+1) saturates, so the IDEAL-lossless droop from the wire load on a FIXED tank is small: bank 2 (5 pull-up cells) goes m = 10 -> m' = 7.499, ideal rail 1.6500 -> 1.6014 V, -2.9 %. I predict the MEASURED droop is LARGER, 5-12 %, because the added load also costs switch and series loss. I predict the row stays above the 0.9642 V level-restoring floor at Cw = 2.400 fF and may cross below it at Cw = 9.216 fF.
E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.P6_pass_fail: the committed T = 150 / dV = 1.65 row passes the 90 % settling bar with only 0.387 points of margin. I predict it FAILS that bar at Cw = 2.400 fF on a fixed tank (W1) and is RECOVERED by the rail-matched tank (W2). Under the fcrit S3 functional criterion I predict W1 still passes 32/32.
E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.P7_beat: the MEASURED steady-state stage time (banktank A3 metric, t_dv(k) - t_dv(k-1), never composed) lengthens by 10-20 % at Cw = 2.400 fF.
E_MY_PRE_STATED_EXPECTATION.P8_area_price: the rail-matched tank grows as 1 + n_hi*Cw/C_bank = 1.20 (n_hi = 3) to 1.33 (n_hi = 5) at Cw = 2.400 fF; at MIM 1.5 fF/um^2 the four tanks go from 959.4 um^2 to ~1218 um^2. This is the area half of the area/power-for-speed exchange and is reported as a cost, not a footnote.

F_BOOKINGS_every_one_is_a_BOUND.ideal_CMOS_supply: the CMOS comparator's VDD is an ideal voltage source. BOOKING. Direction: FAVOURS CMOS (a real regulator adds loss), so the reported ratio is conservative for QAL.
F_BOOKINGS_every_one_is_a_BOUND.ideal_tank_precharge: the QAL tank is a linear capacitor pre-charged by .ic; its generation is NOT costed in the free rows. BOOKING. Direction: FAVOURS QAL. The committed 'topup' variant costs the recharge switch; Phase 1 reports the free rows and says so.
F_BOOKINGS_every_one_is_a_BOUND.ideal_gate_drives: VHI and every transfer/park gate PWL are ideal sources; their energy IS metered (egt, ehi integrators) but their generation is not. BOOKING, both sides, direction FAVOURS QAL (CMOS needs no such rail).
F_BOOKINGS_every_one_is_a_BOUND.lumped_wire_C: Cw is a lumped linear capacitor in W1-W6, Q1-Q2, C1. BOOKING applied IDENTICALLY to both sides. W7 runs the same load as a 3-segment pi RC ladder to bound the error.
F_BOOKINGS_every_one_is_a_BOUND.linear_wire_cap: wire capacitance is genuinely linear, so the linear-cap idealisation is not a booking -- but its VALUE is a min-width, min-pitch Metal2 assumption stated in section A.
F_BOOKINGS_every_one_is_a_BOUND.no_via_or_jog_capacitance: the rotate wire is modelled as straight min-width Metal2 of the mean rotate length. Vias (Via1 0.0361 um^2, 20 ohm) and jogs are NOT included. BOOKING. Direction: UNDERSTATES the wire, which UNDERSTATES whichever side wire capacitance favours.
